name: TTP-PAYMENTS
ttps: Avoid direct deposit; use third-party bank accounts, money-transfer/e-money services, crypto, Chinese/Vietnamese accounts, payment proxies, and rapid routing/consolidation.

sources.support: OFSI lists payment to accounts in another person’s name, EMI/MSB and crypto use, China-based bank accounts, and enablers who consolidate earnings
MSMT documents use of bank and payment-platform accounts, facilitators, and fiat-to-cryptocurrency conversion to collect and launder IT-worker earnings
sources.locator: report pp. 64-66; Annexes 13, 17-18 | Original official publication page: https://msmt.info/Publications/detail/MSMT%20Report/4221

sources.support: The Japanese alert identifies third-party accounts, cryptoassets, and money-transfer services as payment warning signs
The joint alert describes use of third-party payment accounts and cryptocurrency to receive and route IT-work earnings
